exposure: serum HtrA1 levels at 15 and 20 weeks of gestation
serum HtrA3 levels at 15 and 20 weeks of gestation
cohort: The participants were a nested case-control subset of 665 samples (330 controls, 335 cases) from the Adelaide SCOPE cohort, including pregnancies that developed preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, preterm birth, or small for gestational age birth.
finding: Lower serum HtrA3 levels at 15 weeks of gestation were significantly associated with the later development of late-onset preeclampsia and small for gestational age birth.
gest_age: Measurements taken at 15 and 20 weeks of gestation.
